Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Is a male or female greater than or equal to 18 years of age at Screening
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is identified as a male, and there is no information suggesting he is under 18.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Is willing and able to sign and date (or has a legally authorized representative willing to sign and date) a written (or electronic) informed consent form or provide equivalent consent per Food and Drug Administration guidelines on COVID-19 clinical trials
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a documented, laboratory-confirmed severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection as determined by polymerase chain reaction, a SARS-CoV-2 antigen test, or another commercial or public health assay, within 3 days (72 hours) of randomization
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a documented COVID-19 diagnosis, but the timing of the laboratory confirmation relative to randomization is not specified.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has COVID-19 of moderate severity, as defined by the following: Positive testing by standard reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction assay or equivalent testing; Symptoms of illness with COVID-19, which could include any of the following: cough, fever, shortness of breath, chest pain, abdominal pain, nausea/vomiting, diarrhea, body aches, weakness/fatigue, or new loss of taste or smell; Clinical signs suggestive of illness with COVID-19, such as respiratory rate greater than or equal to 20 breaths per minute, saturation of oxygen greater than 93% on room air at sea level, or heart rate greater than or equal to 90 beats per minute; and No clinical signs indicative of severe or critical severity
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is experiencing acute respiratory failure, which is indicative of severe COVID-19, thus violating the criterion for moderate severity.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has an NIAID ordinal scale score <5
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The NIAID ordinal scale score is not provided in the patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Is on high-flow oxygen or any form of noninvasive ventilation, excluding continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) alone for sleep disorders (e.g., obstructive sleep apnea)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is receiving oxygen therapy at 2.0 liters per minute via nasal route, which is considered noninvasive ventilation.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has significant cardiovascular disease, defined by myocardial infarction, arterial thromboembolism, or cerebrovascular thromboembolism within 3 months prior to randomization; symptomatic dysrhythmias or unstable dysrhythmias requiring medical therapy; angina requiring therapy; symptomatic peripheral vascular disease; New York Heart Association Class 3 or 4 congestive heart failure; Grade 3 hypertension (diastolic blood pressure greater than or equal to 100 mmHg or systolic blood pressure greater than or equal to 160 mmHg); history of congenital prolonged QT syndrome, or known dyslipidemia
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has cardiomyopathy, but there is no specific information on the severity or recent events related to cardiovascular disease.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Is currently taking any investigational products, other than the study drug
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is receiving hydroxychloroquine and tocilizumab, but it is unclear if these are investigational products or standard treatments.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has any other condition that, in the opinion of the Investigator, could interfere with (or for which the treatment might interfere with) the conduct of the clinical trial or interpretation of the clinical trial results or that would place the subject at undue risk by participating in the clinical trial
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has multiple comorbidities, but it is unclear if these would interfere with the trial or place the patient at undue risk without the investigator's opinion.

Recap: The patient meets the age and consent criteria but has severe COVID-19, violating the moderate severity requirement. The patient is on noninvasive ventilation, violating that exclusion criterion. Other exclusion criteria remain unclear due to insufficient data.
